---
name: iac-01-design
description: Produce a bounded workload design from an accepted assignment without generating infrastructure.
agent: azure-architect
---

Read `AGENTS.md` and apply the user-supplied accepted assignment. Missing inputs,
owners, limits or material decisions block execution; do not guess a package ID.
Use `docs/delivery/workload-guidance.md`, `docs/delivery/workload-checks.md` WV01-WV03 and
`delivery/templates/design-release.md`. Produce the scoped design with diagrams,
resource/SKU/region inventory, AVM candidates, contracts and gate-specific criteria.
Return it for snapshot preparation and independent review. Do not release the design,
generate Bicep, contact Azure or automatically execute the next prompt.
